provenance.sample: bounded sequence, not the whole history: counts, rates and injectability hold for these sessions only
provenance.builder: local/facts.mjs commandDigest, one digest per client session (copies of one transcript merged by call id)
provenance.selection: for each fact, its sessions in time order from proposal until it is active with at least 4 exercised sessions (all of them if it never is); up to 2 newest sessions per must-not-produce signal; the 2 newest sessions of at least 5 commands that all succeeded; browser-mcp: every session
provenance.approved: owner, 2026-11-11: these repos and facts, and an empty edited-file set counts as disjoint

rules.activation: 3 confirming sessions whose edited-file sets are disjoint from the union of earlier counted sets; an empty set is disjoint
rules.retirement: an active, unpinned fact retires after 2 consecutive contradicting sessions
rules.exercised: from the proposing session on, a session that ran the fact's program, ran its trigger, confirmed it or ran its fix
rules.fired: an exercised session that confirmed the fact or ran its fix with a recorded success
rules.injectable: active, at least 4 exercised sessions and a firing rate of at least 0.40

facts.statement: Run `gh` as `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_TOKEN gh ...`; with GITHUB_TOKEN set, `gh auth switch` fails.
literals: env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_TOKEN gh auth switch
The value of the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable is being used for authentication.

must_not_produce.why: the global `wrangler` reported `Not logged in` in 2 sessions: an account login state, which no detector covers, not a missing tool or a repo fact
